promotion_rules: Deployed is not verified until runtime readback and acceptance pass.
The production branch moves only to a commit that contains every source change actually installed for that release and no uninstalled production-affecting candidate beyond the declared baseline.
Every deployment PR must state component version, exact source commit, deployment identity/version where safe, readback evidence, acceptance result and rollback baseline.
Runtime secrets, deployment URLs, spreadsheet IDs and private project IDs must not be added to this public repository.
One component has one active production version. Older versions remain history, not parallel active implementations.
Any production-affecting PR left open after supersession must be closed or explicitly labelled as a historical/reference branch in its PR body.
